newsitem.title: ITALY: CIR pummelled with Olivetti on bourse.
newsitem.headline: CIR pummelled with Olivetti on bourse.

text.p: Shares in De Benedetti family holdings CIR and Cofide suffered alongside information technology group Olivetti in early trade, with Olivetti freefalling nine percent.
CIR fell 6.12 percent to 600 lire per share while Cofide sank 3.52 percent to 370 lire.
Olivetti, which had begun 3.5 percent lower, shed more percentage points to stand nine percent down at 470 only 20 minutes after the bourse opening.

Loss-making Olivetti was struck by a fresh negative development late on Monday when Italian bourse watchdog Consob said it had asked Olivetti to supply answers to 16 points it wants clarified regarding the group's financial performance.
A spokesman for Consob said the watchdog expected Olivetti to reply once the bourse had closed on Tuesday.
